_metadata.description: Post-launch operational capabilities: an autofix registry for deterministically-fixable findings, a fleet storage inventory/dashboard, migration intelligence, a Postgres->SQLite advisor, and backup/restore-readiness detection. All persist to the scenario's own dogfooded SQLite store.

requirements.title: Autofix registry
requirements.description: Wire packages/maturity-go/autofix.Registry for the autofixable findings (seam-wiring scaffold, namespace-helper rewrites, central->per-domain schema relocation, defer rows.Close() insertion). Preview/apply RPCs must be idempotent (apply twice => second is a no-op) and each autofix carries a before/after fixture. AutofixableCount is stamped into the assessment.

validation.notes: PreviewFix then ApplyFix produces the expected diff; a second ApplyFix is a no-op.
AutofixableCount in the assessment equals the number of auto fix_class findings.

requirements.title: Fleet storage inventory & dashboard
requirements.description: Enumerate the fleet and classify each scenario's engines (SQLite/Postgres/Qdrant/Redis/file from service.json resources + code-facts), namespace-helper adoption, isolation readiness, and storage_stage. `storage-health fleet --json` returns per-scenario + aggregate; 'show all Postgres scenarios' is one query. Persisted to the scenario's per-domain SQLite store.

validation.notes: fleet --json returns a per-scenario engine + isolation-readiness report and an aggregate summary.
Filtering by engine returns exactly the scenarios declaring that engine.

requirements.title: Migration intelligence + Postgres->SQLite advisor
requirements.description: Migration intelligence (schema drift, non-idempotent detection, brownfield migration-hygiene, greenfield migration-debt — informational per storage_stage) plus a Postgres->SQLite advisor that scores engine fitness and lists per-scenario 'what is wrong / what is autofixable', producing a ranked migration-candidate list.

validation.notes: The advisor produces a ranked migration-candidate list with per-scenario fitness scores.
Greenfield migration-debt surfaces as informational (MIGRATION_DEBT, L4 advisory), never as a hard failure.

requirements.title: Backup/restore-readiness detection
requirements.description: Detect data-persisting scenarios with no registered data-backup-manager target and emit BACKUP_TARGET_MISSING (L4 advisory) as both a finding and a standalone readiness report. Uses the data-backup-manager dependency to resolve registered targets.

validation.notes: A data-persisting scenario without a registered backup target produces BACKUP_TARGET_MISSING and appears in the readiness report.
